HalfBlind.Label: Half-blind
HalfBlind.Hint: Blind rolls are partially visible to message author. This solves the problem of players being uncertain if their roll even happened.

HalfBlind.Label: Half-blind for others
HalfBlind.Hint: Also allows to see if other players (but not the GM) made a roll.

AllSeeingGM.Label: All Seeing GM
AllSeeingGM.Hint: Do not alter visibility for GM.
